impact_summary.value: 의약품을 산업용 제품과 같은 장비에서 제조해 교차오염 위험이 있으며, FDA는 기존 회신이 CGMP 준수를 입증하기에 불충분하다고 판단했습니다.

evidence.quote: It is unacceptable as a matter of CGMP to continue manufacturing drugs using the same equipment that you use to manufacture these non-pharmaceutical products due to the risk of cross-contamination.

affected_work.value: OTC 항균 손비누, 소독제 및 손 소독제 제조와 의약품·산업용 제품의 공용 제조 장비, 세척·용수·공정 관리, 품질부서 감독 및 기록 관리가 대상입니다.

evidence.quote: Your firm manufactures over-the-counter (OTC) antibacterial hand soap, antiseptics, and hand sanitizer 1 drug products. You manufacture these drug products using the same equipment that you use to manufacture numerous non-pharmaceutical materials in your facility, including industrial detergents and disinfectants.

recommendation.value: 공용 장비 사용을 중단할지 확인하고, 병행 제조 시 전용 장비와 구역 분리 계획을 제출해야 합니다. 공유 장비로 생산한 제품의 오염 위험 평가와 유통 중 제품의 품질·환자 안전 대응 계획도 제시해야 합니다.

evidence.quote: In response to this letter, confirm whether you will discontinue manufacturing drugs on shared equipment in your facility. If you intend to continue to manufacture both pharmaceutical and non-pharmaceutical products at your facility, provide a plan to show how you will separate the areas in which you will maintain dedicated manufacturing equipment for your pharmaceutical manufacturing and industrial product manufacturing operations. In addition, provide a risk assessment for all drugs you have previously produced on equipment shared with industrial products.
After you receive this letter, respond to this office in writing within 15 working days 2 . Specify what you have done to address any violations and to prevent their recurrence.
